verdict.rationale: Reducto's Extract offers a first-party citations option where, when enabled, every field includes bounding box coordinates pointing to the source text. Studio adds a citation viewer for human verification. The docs do not explicitly say extract citations carry a page number or the verbatim source snippet; page position is documented only for Parse elements, not Extract fields. Missing for 10: explicit per-field page number and source-snippet text in Extract citations, a documented citation response schema, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every extracted field carries provenance — page number, bounding box, source snippet — so agents can cite and humans can verify

citations.quote: Citations tell you exactly where each extracted value came from in the document. When enabled, every field includes bounding box coordinates pointing to the source text.
